nameForms.name: Emperor of the Romans
nameForms.note: Early imperial style of the Carolingians.
nameForms.noteCn: 加洛林早期的皇帝称谓。

nameForms.name: Holy Roman Emperor
nameForms.note: Style fixed from the Ottonian revival onward.
nameForms.noteCn: 自奥托王朝复兴后固定的称谓。

holders.note: Crowned Emperor by Pope Leo III.
holders.noteCn: 由教宗利奥三世加冕。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Charlemagne.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父查理曼。

holders.note: Co-emperor under the Ordinatio Imperii.
holders.noteCn: 依〈帝国条例〉为共治皇帝。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Lothair I.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父洛泰尔一世。

holders.note: Crowned by Pope John VIII.
holders.noteCn: 由教宗若望八世加冕。

holders.note: Last Carolingian to hold the reunited empire.
holders.noteCn: 最后一位短暂统一帝国的加洛林皇帝。

holders.note: After Charles the Fat's deposition, the empire fragmented and the imperial title entered an interregnum.
holders.noteCn: 胖子查理被废后帝国分裂，帝位进入空位期。
holders.sideNote: Italian claimants briefly held the imperial title, but their authority was largely limited to northern Italy before the title fell vacant after 924.
holders.sideNoteCn: 意大利的几位争位者一度持有帝号，但实际权力主要局限于北意大利；924 年后帝号正式空缺。
holders.arrowNote: Charles the Fat's deposition opened the interregnum.
holders.arrowNoteCn: 胖子查理被废，帝位进入空位期。

holders.note: After Conrad IV's death, rival claimants — Richard of Cornwall (1257–1272) and Alfonso X of Castile (1257–1275) — held the title without effective rule until Rudolf I.
holders.noteCn: 康拉德四世去世后，对立国王康沃尔的理查（1257–1272）与卡斯蒂利亚的阿方索十世（1257–1275）空有头衔而无实治，直至鲁道夫一世。
holders.sideNote: Rival claimants left the crown vacant until the Habsburg election of 1273.
holders.sideNoteCn: 竞争候选者使王位空悬，直至 1273 年哈布斯堡当选。
